title: NeonTiersTagger
description: This mod adds rank displays next to your name from NeonTiers
body:
# NeonTiersTagger

See player skill at a glance. NeonTiersTagger displays each player's ELO rating directly above their head in-game, pulled live from your server's ranking database — no more alt-tabbing to a leaderboard website mid-fight.

## Features

- **Live ELO tags** — shows `[ELO] PlayerName` above every player you see, color-coded by skill tier (gray for low ELO all the way up to gold for the top bracket)
- **24 gamemode support** — switch between Vanilla, UHC, Pot, NethPot, SMP, Sword, Axe, Mace, Cart, Creeper, DiaSMP, OGVanilla, ShieldlessUHC, SpearMace, SpearElytra, Stick Fight, Trident, Boxing, Combo, Bridge, No Debuff, OP, Soup, and Fireball Fight directly from the in-game config screen
- **Retired player marking** — optionally flag retired players with a distinct tag so you know their ELO is no longer active
- **Smart caching** — results are cached and refreshed in the background, so the game never stutters waiting on a network request and tags don't flicker back to "Loading..."
- **Fully configurable** — adjust request timeout, cache duration, and debug logging through an in-game Mod Menu screen, no file editing required

## Color tiers

| ELO range | Color |
|---|---|
| LT1-HT1 | Gold |
| LT2-HT2 | Silver |
| HT3 | Light Brown |
| LT3 | Dark Brown |
| HT4 | Light Purple |
| LT4 | Dark Purple |
| Unranked | Dark Gray |
| Retired | Dark Red |

## Requirements

- Fabric Loader 0.18.1+
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API
- Mod Menu (optional, for the config screen)

## Notes

This mod is client-side only and connects to a Supabase-backed ranking database. It's built for a specific server's ranking system — if you're not on that server, ELO lookups will show "Unranked" since your stats won't exist in the database.
